text:
After receiving migraine treatment including hijab, neck and shoulder physical therapy, ultrasound, chiropractic, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI),
my migraine pain has significantly decreased. Previously, I experienced pain 4-5 days a week. Now, the pain has almost completely disappeared. While there is still some pain, it's much less frequent and the severity has decreased considerably. I only experience some pain during my menstrual cycle.
I would like to express my sincere gratitude to the doctor for her treatment recommendations, which have greatly reduced my migraines, which I suffered from for 15 years. Thank you so much! (The doctor is very kind.) 😃😃😃😃
